notes: al pi YHWH is split rather than fused: al takes the compound according to and pi takes the commandment, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 governs.
The explicit hemmah carries the ASV's who under rule 17's recast relative clause, the copula staying with the predicate rashei under rule 20.
kol takes all only and the suffix takes of them, headed on the pronoun, exactly as rule 19 directs.
